items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And Minetta told me that Pete told Eddie he was a bonehead...

ctx.x: Well that was mostly a family band. It was either Lou Warner and what was the bull card saxophone player, but Charlie, Henry, Pete, those three were standards. Alfred Whitting was the standard drummer most of the time.
Eddie Pearson was a nephew. Yeah, he was a nephew. And Minetta told me that Pete told Eddie he was a bonehead and he never would learn how to play drum.
